Where every number comes from

official Manufacturer specification, transcribed from the published sheet with the URL and the date it was read. Every figure on the site today is this tier.
measured A measurement of our own. The library holds none yet, so the site claims none. When the first one lands it appears here, labelled and dated, and it will say what it disagreed with.
user A reader's log. Submissions are not open yet. When they are, a figure is held in review until three independent logs of the same pairing agree, and it stays marked as a user log afterwards.

We publish no figure without a tier and a verification date — including the ones that say we do not know.

Every figure on WattPair is labeled by source tier—official spec, lab measurement, or user log—with its verification date.
